Definition: Identifier of the included synthesis, usually first author and year. Use the recorded identifier for joins; do not infer publication year from it.
Category definitions: e.g., smith_2020: Unique ID of the review: firstauthor_year format

Definition: DOI of the included synthesis, as recorded. A URL or placeholder can occur when a DOI is unavailable; trim whitespace when matching.
Category definitions: e.g., 10.1093/beheco/ar: Digital Object Identifier (e.g., 10.1093/beheco/ar). Matched from journal metadata

Definition: Title of the citing policy document or source, as extracted.
Category definitions: Free text: Title of the policy document. Copy from the cover/title page

Definition: Number of repeated appearances recorded within the same synthesis in PlumX. Blank means no repeat count was entered, not a numerical zero. Do not use as a row weight.
Category definitions: interger: Times the policy document was repeated within the same synthesis in PlumX

Definition: Publication year of the policy source; the most recent year was recorded for revisions or multiple versions.
Category definitions: YYYY: Policy document year of publication. The most recent year if revisions or multiple versions exist

Definition: Identifier or DOI of the citing policy source.
Category definitions: e.g., DOI or ISSN: Policy document identifier

Definition: Institution, organisation or author responsible for the policy source.
Category definitions: E.g., UNEP, DFO Canada, Quiet Communities Inc.: Institution or group responsible for the policy publication

Definition: Government policy: Published by national or subnational governments (e.g, branches, departments, secretariats, etc.); Intergovernmental policy: Published by multinational organizations (e.g., UNEP, EU, WHO); NGO report: Published by non-profit, NGO organizations; Academic advisory: Published by academic expert panels. Can be a synthesis or technical advice; Regulatory Submission: Formal applications or impact statements submitted to authorities by proponents—independent from the government—seeking permits or approvals; Think Tank: Published by declared Think Tank organizations; Other document: Doesn’t match any above; Unclear: Not identifiable

Definition: Country or geographical scope of the source; the dataset also contains regions, international scope and Nairobi. For S10 only, the plotting code maps Nairobi to Kenya and UK constituent countries to the United Kingdom, and reports EU, International and Mixed separately.
Category definitions: Name of the country or region (e.g. Canada, United States, Germany), European Union, International, Other, Unclear: What country or region does the document cover or originate from? Prefer authoring country; multiple categories allowed

Definition: International: Applies to multiple countries or globally; Regional: Applies to a multi-country region (e.g., European Union); National: Country-wide application; Subnational: Applies to a province, state, and/or municipal level; Mixed: More than one level; Other: Special categories (e.g., sector-specific); Unclear: Not clearly stated
Category definitions: International: Applies to multiple countries or globally | Regional: Applies to a multi-country region (e.g., European Union) | National: Country-wide application | Subnational: Applies to a province, state, and/or municipal level | Mixed: More than one level | Other: Special categories (e.g., sector-specific) | Unclear: Not clearly stated

Definition: Terrestrial: Policy about land-based environments; Marine: Marine systems (e.g.  Pacific Ocean, bahias); Freshwater: Freshwater systems (e.g.,   rivers, lakes, ponds); Coastal: Coastal systems (e.g.  Estuaries, Urban coast); Urban: Built or human-modified environments (e.g. cities); Mixed: Covers more than one context; Other: Not clearly ecological or atypical settings (e.g. rural areas); Unclear: Not clearly specified (e.g. when the policy talked about computer tools used for any environment)

Source link used to locate the policy record, usually Overton.

Definition: Whether full text was available during extraction.
Category definitions: yes/no: If the full text is available

Definition: Link or availability note for the full policy text.
Category definitions: Free text: URL or DOI of the policy document, link to official agency or institutional site

Definition: Extraction notes about the policy source and its citation or relevance.
